title: Let's teach for mastery -- not test scores | Sal Khan
summary: Sal Khan of Khan Academy argues that schools push students forward with gaps in their foundations, and that students should instead master concepts at their own pace. He compares it to building a house on an unfinished foundation.
why: HN commenters cite it when discussing how gaps in basic knowledge pile up and how mastery learning could fix that.

quote.text: Here is a TED talk where Sal Khan of Khan Academy talks about this
